title: Mixed Event — Mermaid Admiration — Episode1 Here Come the Ambassadors!

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime has begun working as ambassadors for Phoenix Wonderland. Their first visit will be to an outdoor stage on a beach. Hearing this, Nene remembers the performance of "The Little Mermaid" that she saw when she was little...

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, it was the first movie club meeting we've had in a while, but it lasted longer than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm guessing the others have started practicing for... Hm?
se_event_mermaid_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
W-Wahhh!!
Too high! Too high!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow! That's so awesome!
That suit lets you jump super high!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe. I've made several improvements to the Star Training Suit so that you'll now be able to leap up to the stage with little to no effort.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't care! How do I stop this thing?! Rui, let me down!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
They're at it again.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, guys. Sorry for being late...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hi, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, you got here sooner than I expected. Did your club meeting end already?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. All we did was write up some activity reports. More importantly, he...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Tell me how to stop this thing right now!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Could you please stop that thing so that he'll shut up...?
se_event_mermaid_2021_001

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ugh... My head's still bouncing up and down...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, Tsukasa's finally back, so can we get started with practice?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, don't you know what I went through just now?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Will you shut... Well, you seem okay now, so let's get started...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, Nene!
There's something we need to talk about before we start!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: There is?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, indeed.
It's actually just about time for...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, there they are.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh? They...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hang on, they're Emu's...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Big bros!
Welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Guh!
What did I tell you about tackling people?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I know that feeling all too well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Them being here means...
Is this about us becoming ambassadors?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, you are correct.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
Allow me to explain once more.
Phoenix Wonderland would like you to become its ambassadors and travel outside of the park to promote it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, and you can both rest easy because your park is in good hands! We promise not to disappoint!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But there is one question I'd like to ask before we proceed. Promoting the park does seem necessary, but why make us ambassadors?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Initially, we were going to use social media as a promotional platform, but now you wish to have us travel outside of the park to promote it. Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Ah, that's because we've changed our target demographic.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You have...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Fortunately, your little stunt helped attract the younger generation of guests we were after.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Which is why we've decided to set our sights on those living in other parts of the country.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: This park is at the heart of Shibuya, so it is able to attract many guests from within the city. However, we rarely ever see guests traveling great distances to visit.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Compared with other parks, our IP share is on the low side. As a result, we don't have a reliable way of attracting guests from other parts of the country.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Partnering with Riley Entertainment remedies some of these issues, but we've decided not to rely so much on existing IPs.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I see...
And you wish to make us the faces of the park because of the success we found through social media.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Indeed. Rumors of how you're all high school students have even begun spreading, which has only added to your fame.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Today, we'd like to relay the details of yesterday's meeting, as well as where your first stop will be.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Fantastic! So the first stop on my road to stardom has already been decided!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay!!
And?! Where do we get to go?!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Yes, your first destination will be Phoenix Ocean Resort.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What?! Phoenix Ocean Resort?! The five-star hotel...?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. Phoenix Hotel & Resort being an Otori Group subsidiary would make things quite a bit easier for us as well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wh-Why do you know all that, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I decided to look up what I could about the Otori Group while I was coming up with ideas for our last show.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A five-star resort would be the perfect stage for a star such as myself!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I feel like people who go to fancy resorts aren't really the same as the people who like going to amusement parks...

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line:
That shouldn't be an issue.
We're interested in not the hotel-goers but those coming to visit the beach.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Phoenix Ocean Resort has an open-air Beach Stage that already attracts a lot of visitors due to it being a sort of public amphitheater.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We would like you to put on a show that is not only family friendly, like the ones you are already doing, but also appeals to a wider audience.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see.
I can't wait to see the Beach Stage...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I came across some information regarding this stage. Apparently, it's literally built where the sea meets the sand.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehehe... We should be able to include some effects that we normally don't get to...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! A show by the sea!
Yay!! Cannonball!!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Hey, will all of you settle down a little? Try not to forget that you're ambassadors for this park.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We know!
We promise to give you the best show possible!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: You're scheduled to perform for three days. One performance in the morning and one in the evening each day for a total of six times.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Next, regarding what facilities will be available to you...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I can't believe we're staying at the hotel and performing there for three days...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I thought they were just gonna have us appear as guests for small events or local festivals and stuff.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Can we really help promote the park...? Doing shows outside of the park is probably gonna feel really different compared to normal...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Is something bothering you, Nene? You seem concerned...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: N-No, it's nothing...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm not sure what's on your mind, but I'm certain that it's nothing you need to be afraid of...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We've already succeeded in putting on a show that hundreds of guests got to see and helped change the course of Phoenix Wonderland's future.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Traveling about to perform shows should feel like nothing at all to you at this point, no?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess you're right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We managed to pull off something that crazy, so we should be fine even if we're somewhere that's completely new to us.)

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Again, your audience will include both children and adults, so in terms of what to perform, we'd like you to do something light and cheerful.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: As long as you meet those prerequisites, the rest will be up to you.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
But no funny business, got it?
We can't have you pulling another one of your stunts...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Funny business...?
I believe that depends on your definition of the word funny...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You're already planning something, aren't you...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No matter. It is settled! We will perform a light and cheerful show that visitors of all ages can enjoy while promoting Phoenix Wonderland!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And we'll show everyone just how great Wonderlands×Showtime is at the same time!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We promise to make everything super fun and bring back as many guests as we can!

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Good. We'll be counting on you, Emu...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So why don't we get started by coming up with some show ideas? Any thoughts?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I know! We get to go to the beach this time, so why don't we do a show about us being fish on an undersea adventure?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
The sea, huh? What about pirates?
We could bury some treasure on the beach and dig it up during our performance!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, everything we need for a pirate show does seem to be in place.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Is there anything you'd like to do, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
The sea...
Well...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's a tad old-fashioned, but the Little Mermaid might be nice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The Little Mermaid? That's also a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Do you like the Little Mermaid, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I saw a rendition of it when I was little, and I can still remember how amazing the lead actress was at singing... I doubt I'll ever forget it...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: She's the reason I decided to start performing in shows and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That was such a long time ago. Back then, I...)

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: (Wow, there's so many people...!)

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: (I can't wait to hear the mermaid sing! What do you think she's gonna be like?)

rows.Speaker: Little Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, it's starting...!)
